items.title: Meta 拓展自研芯片战略：从计算领域延伸至网络领域
items.summary_zh: Meta 发布 MTIA 300，这是首款针对排序与推荐模型优化的自研加速器，将网络接口集成进芯片，应对占参数 99%+ 的嵌入表通信瓶颈。配上 12 个 800G RDMA NIC 与 16 个消息引擎后，40 卡跑 1500 亿参数模型时通信耗时约为同级 GPU 集群的 1/3.9，计算吞吐损失低于 0.5%。这标志着 Meta 自研芯片从计算走向网络，未来两年还将推出四代后续产品。
items.summary_en: Meta announced MTIA 300, its first custom accelerator aimed at ranking and recommendation models, and moved networking into the chip. Since embedding tables can hold over 99% of parameters, communication is a major bottleneck; the chip packs twelve 800Gb/s RDMA NICs and 16 dedicated message engines to relieve it. In a 40-accelerator test with a 150B-parameter model, communication time dropped to about 1/3.9 of a comparable GPU cluster while compute throughput loss stayed below 0.5%. More MTIA generations are planned.

items.title: RTX 4060 跑 35B 模型，每秒 39 Token？伯克利、MIT 联手开源 FreeToken
items.summary_zh: 伯克利与MIT的研究者开源了FreeToken，一款面向消费级硬件的MoE模型推理引擎。它以动态协同调度替代静态卸载，在专家权重缓存未命中时按实时PCIe吞吐量把计算分给CPU与GPU，并复用中间注意力状态；作者报告称同模型下解码比Ollama/llama.cpp快3～4倍，预填充快6～30倍。
items.summary_en: UC Berkeley and MIT researchers have open-sourced FreeToken, an inference engine aimed at running sparse MoE models efficiently on consumer hardware. Instead of stalling the GPU when expert weights miss the cache, it dynamically schedules token computation across CPU and GPU cores based on available PCIe throughput and reuses attention states. The authors report 3-4x faster decoding and 6-30x faster prefill than llama.cpp/Ollama on the same models.

items.title: Uber GitFarm：面向大规模单体代码库的 Git 即服务平台
items.summary_zh: Uber推出Git即服务平台GitFarm，把大规模单体仓库的Git操作集中到共享服务，客户端不再需要本地克隆，资源占用降低80%以上。平台将预热的检出挂到沙箱中执行命令，完整检出从10～15分钟缩短到500ms内；某代码所有权服务迁移后CPU从70多核降至16核、内存从400GB降至32GB。
items.summary_en: Uber has introduced GitFarm, a Git-as-a-service platform that centralizes Git operations across its large monorepos. Client systems no longer keep full clones, reducing resource usage by over 80%; the service pools warm checkouts and runs commands in sandboxes, cutting a full checkout from 10–15 minutes to under 500ms. One code-ownership service dropped from 70+ CPUs and 400GB RAM to 16 CPUs and 32GB RAM.

items.title: FlexGanttFX 正式开源
items.summary_zh: FlexGanttFX 由 Dirk Lemmerman 开发 15 年后以 AGPL 许可正式开源，是一个基于 JavaFX 的甘特图资源调度框架，可在桌面端和移动端运行。它借助 Canvas 单画布渲染实现复杂图表的高性能，并把时区、周末等因素纳入时间模型。AGPL 要求修改版对网络使用者同样公开源码，SaaS 团队选择前需评估合规影响。
items.summary_en: After 15 years of development, Dirk Lemmerman released FlexGanttFX as open source under AGPL—a JavaFX-based resource scheduling framework for Gantt charts that runs on desktop and mobile. It uses a single Canvas to render even complex charts at high performance and treats time zones and weekends as part of its time model. The AGPL license also obligates modified versions to be opened to network users, so SaaS teams should evaluate the implications before adoption.

items.summary_en: Microsoft expanded its Foundry model router to 28 regions for standard global deployments (up from 2) and 21 for data-region deployments, refreshing the model pool with Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8 and the GPT-5.6 series while dropping four end-of-life models. Default configurations pick up the change automatically; teams that pin a model subset won't update. The pool shift can alter response behavior even though API stability is maintained.

items.summary_zh: 帖子讨论如何实现“苹果风”的液态玻璃视觉效果，并盘点现有方案：GitHub 仓库 iyinchao/liquid-glass-studio 已能渲染效果，但目前只支持图片、不支持 HTML；提到的 SVG 版本在提供的摘要处截断。
items.summary_en: A post about recreating Apple-style liquid glass reviews existing approaches. The GitHub repository iyinchao/liquid-glass-studio renders the effect convincingly, but only as images—HTML isn't supported yet; a SVG version is mentioned before the supplied text cuts off. Helpful for front-end developers experimenting with fluid glass-like UI visuals.

items.summary_zh: 前端开发者“小张同学”结合近期每天用 AI 写代码的体验，分享了一套 AI 全栈开发实践，并坦言手写代码能力已经明显下降。他认为按当前节奏，AI 编写代码会在更多场景替代人工。适合正在搭建 AI 辅助编程流程的开发者参考，也提醒自己别丢掉基本功。
items.summary_en: A front-end developer who goes by “小张同学” shares full-stack development practices built around writing code with AI every day. He admits his hand-coding ability has dropped noticeably and argues AI-generated code will keep replacing manual work in more scenarios. The post is useful for developers building AI-assisted workflows and doubles as a warning about foundational-skills atrophy.
